listen_address.description: IP address the service listens on (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port number for client connections.

db_path.description: Absolute path to the directory where database files (indices, data, cache) are stored.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for parallel query processing. Set to match available CPU cores.

enable_compression.description: Whether to compress stored records to save disk space and I/O (may increase CPU usage).

cache_size_mb.description: Size of the in-memory query result cache in megabytes.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (debug, info, warn, error).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'stdout' to log directly to the console.

auth_method.description: Authentication method for clients (none = open, password = basic auth, cert = mutual TLS).

password_file.description: Path to the file containing usernames and hashed passwords (used when auth_method = password).

tls_cert.description: Path to the server TLS certificate (PEM format), required when auth_method = cert.

tls_key.description: Path to the server TLS private key (PEM format), required when auth_method = cert.

access_rules.description: List of allowed client IP ranges. Each entry specifies a network and optional prefix length (CIDR), plus a human-readable description.

network.description: Base IP address of the allowed range (IPv4).

prefix_length.description: CIDR prefix length (e.g., 24 = /24 subnet). Defaults to 32 (single IP).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the rule.

idle_timeout_sec.description: Maximum idle time (in seconds) before a client connection is closed.

query_timeout_sec.description: Maximum allowed time (in seconds) for a single query before it is aborted.
